integrity_statement: The proof uses published nonequivariant homology concentration and independently derives the symmetry character by signed Lefschetz enumeration and a weighted matrix–forest identity. Computer calculations only check finite cases; novelty is not certified by search alone.
scientific_limitations: The character describes the isolated-vertex directed rooted-forest subcomplex; no equivariant collapse of the larger matching complex, integral representation decomposition, or general Specht decomposition is asserted. The first public source was posted 2026-09-06.
title: Cycle-divisibility determinant characters of isolated rooted-forest complexes
